admin_action_one_target_check.name: admin_action_one_target_check
admin_action_one_target_check.value: case when "admin_action"."action" = 'broadcast_send' then "admin_action"."target_user_id" is null and "admin_action"."target_school_id" is null else ("admin_action"."target_user_id" is null) <> ("admin_action"."target_school_id" is null) end

class_extra_replaces_check.name: class_extra_replaces_check
class_extra_replaces_check.value: "class_extra"."replaces_slot_id" is null or "class_extra"."replaces_date" is not null

class_extra_online_campus_check.name: class_extra_online_campus_check
class_extra_online_campus_check.value: ("class_extra"."meeting_url" is null and "class_extra"."auto_meet" = false) or "class_extra"."require_on_campus" = false

class_slot_online_campus_check.name: class_slot_online_campus_check
class_slot_online_campus_check.value: ("class_slot"."meeting_url" is null and "class_slot"."auto_meet" = false) or "class_slot"."require_on_campus" = false
